title: Art as Technique (in Russian Formalist Criticism: Four Essays)

verification.verification_notes: Translation of the 1917 essay 'Art as Device/Technique' confirmed; ostranenie (defamiliarization) and the automatization argument confirmed in the translated text.

limitations: Ostranenie is rendered variously as defamiliarization, estrangement, or making strange; the term's ambiguity is a known translation problem.
